section_summary.extract_value: This 'Analytic strategy' section describes the statistical procedures used: descriptive statistics, Pearson correlations among EMWSS_Peers, BMI, self-compassion, social safeness, body appreciation (BAS), and disordered eating (EDE-Q), and path analyses (SEM) using AMOS with maximum likelihood estimation and bootstrap testing of mediational paths. It references a single proposed theoretical model (Fig. 1) but provides no sample-level descriptive details (e.g., N, age, % white, mean BMI), no survey method, and no explicit statement of multiple studies or study numbering (no 'Study 1'/'Study 2' mentions).
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences used to summarize: 'To explore the characteristics of the sample in terms of the variables in study, descriptive statistics (e.g., means and standard deviations) were used.'; '...product-moment Pearson correlation analyses were conducted.'; 'A series of path analyses ... were conducted using the software AMOS (v.22...)' and 'The Bootstrap resampling method was used...'.
